articles.title: Thousands of servers can be backdoored by exploiting buggy motherboard controllers
articles.content: Baseboard management controllers from the world's biggest manufacturers are a security mess.
articles.titleZh: 数以千计的服务器可以通过利用故障主板控制器进行后门
articles.contentZh: 来自全球最大制造商的踢脚线管理控制器是一个安全问题。

articles.title: Claude published malicious code to the Internet and attacked 3 real companies
articles.content: Had the hacks used conventional methods, someone would likely go to prison.
articles.titleZh: 克劳德向互联网发布恶意代码，攻击3家真实公司
articles.contentZh: 如果黑客使用传统方法，可能会有人入狱。

articles.title: Max-severity Exchange server flaw under active exploitation by Kremlin hackers
articles.content: Exploits can give persistent server access that survives credential rotation and disk re-imaging.
articles.titleZh: 克里姆林宫黑客主动利用的Max-severity Exchange服务器漏洞
articles.contentZh: 漏洞利用可以提供在凭据循环和磁盘重新映像后仍然存在的持久服务器访问权限。

articles.title: Mythos attack on 3rd-round PQC algorithm candidate puts it out of commission
articles.content: HAWK withstood years of testing that had yet to uncover a fatal weakness found through Mythos.
articles.titleZh: 对第三轮PQC算法候选的神话攻击使其失效
articles.contentZh: 霍克经受住了多年的考验，这些考验尚未发现通过神话发现的致命弱点。

articles.title: Zuckerberg’s yacht was closer, but someone else saved a stranded boat
articles.content: Earlier this week, the Alaskan cruise ship Wilderness Legacy rescued a small skiff stranded near Farragut Bay after running out of fuel. But, according to tracking data reviewed by the Alaska Beacon and Halifax Shipping News, the closest vessel was actually Mark Zuckerberg's super yacht, Launchpad.
